intro: Horizontal metal cutting band saws — metal bandsaws for steel, stainless, aluminum and other metals — for fabricators, machine shops and steel service centres across Canada, in two clearly separated lines: the premium Bekamak range built in Turkey, and NovoTech's own value line. Whether you are searching for a manual band saw for metal, a semi-automatic hydraulic bandsaw, an automatic CNC band saw machine or an industrial double column saw for heavy bar and bundles, every machine is here with specifications in inches and millimetres, a CSA-approved panel, spare parts and technical support from Mississauga, ON.

faq_title: Questions we get asked about band saws

faq.q: What is the difference between the Premium and Value lines?
faq.a: Premium-line saws are built by Bekamak in Turkey with European components and the heaviest construction in their class. Value-line saws carry the NovoTech name: proven designs built to our specification at a lower price. Each line has its own pages on this site so you can compare like with like. Both lines come with a CSA-approved electrical panel, a 1-year warranty and spare parts and technical support from Mississauga, ON.

faq.q: Band saw or bandsaw — is there a difference?
faq.a: No. Bandsaw (one word) and band saw (two words) are the same machine: a continuous toothed steel band running over two wheels. Horizontal metal cutting band saws — the machines on this page — cut bar, tube, profile and plate to length; vertical bandsaws are for contour work and woodworking. Google treats both spellings alike, and so do we.

faq.q: How do I choose the size of a band saw?
faq.a: Start with the largest round or rectangular stock you cut regularly and add about 1–2 in (25–50 mm) of clearance. Bekamak model numbers give the round capacity in millimetres (BMSY 440 = 440 mm) and NovoTech value-line model numbers give it in inches (BS-650GA = 18″). Then decide how much automation you need — manual, semi-automatic or automatic — and whether you cut miters. The buying guide on this page walks through each choice.

faq.q: Which saws can cut bundles of tube or bar?
faq.a: Semi-automatic and automatic saws with a hydraulic top clamp can cut bundles; the double-column CS and CGS NC models and the Bekamak XS line are designed for bundle cutting with servo feeding. Ask us for the bundle size of the model you are considering.

faq.q: Do the saws come with a blade and coolant system?
faq.a: Yes — every band saw ships with a bi-metal blade, an electric coolant pump and a blade brush. We stock replacement blades for all sizes in Mississauga, ON.

faq.q: Can I get a saw for 208 V, 240 V or 480 V?
faq.a: Three-phase saws are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request. Some small manual saws are available in single-phase.
Yes. Installation and operator training are available across Canada, and spare parts, blades and technical support are handled from our Mississauga, ON location.
